# DSB Medical

> Changzhou DSB Medical — incontinence care and drug-delivery devices (SMI inhalers, auto-injectors).

- [Home](https://en.dsbmedical.com/): DSB Medical official homepage


## Products & Solutions

- [Products](https://en.dsbmedical.com/products.html): Products and services overview
- [Drug Delivery](https://en.dsbmedical.com/drug-delivery.html): SMI soft-mist inhalers and auto-injectors
- [Inhalation Devices](https://en.dsbmedical.com/inhalation.html): Inhalation devices and metered-dose inhalers
- [FluidMS® Fecal Management](https://en.dsbmedical.com/fluidms.html): Fecal drainage and management system
- [FreeHala™ Inhalation Platform](https://en.dsbmedical.com/freehala.html): Drug-device combination inhalation platform (SMI/DPI/pMDI)
- [DXneb™ Nebulizer](https://en.dsbmedical.com/dxneb.html): Portable mesh nebulizer
- [Goldhaler® MDI](https://en.dsbmedical.com/goldhaler.html): Pressurised metered-dose inhaler (pMDI)
- [Didun® Male External Catheter](https://en.dsbmedical.com/didun.html): External/condom catheter
- [Urine Bag](https://en.dsbmedical.com/urine-bag.html): Urine collection bags and accessories
- [Incontinence Care](https://en.dsbmedical.com/Incontinence.html): Adult incontinence care products
- [Medical Consumables](https://en.dsbmedical.com/Consumables.html): Comprehensive medical consumables
